f9d5bb76961baeef.title: سامسونج توسع تحديث One UI 9 إلى Galaxy A54 وA26 وA27 وA34 وA15 4G

fd04855a6f41c02e.english_title: YC startup offers rewards for unsolved materials science problems for AI
fd04855a6f41c02e.snippet: Discovered Materials, a months-old YC startup that uses AI to find chip materials, is offering $200,000 for each solution to five open materials science problems.
